_assembly: E122 owned-preference repro fixture (LIVE_GEN_COLLECTION). Broad 'collection' of real card names for A/B-ing collectionStrategy=prefer against a live deck generation. Two parts: (1) ~1200 format staples + midrange filler, deterministically random.sample()'d (seed 42) from public/tagger-tags.json's generic ramp/removal/spot-removal/card-advantage/draw/tutor/counterspell/bounce/boardwipe/lifegain/mana-rock/mana-dork/sacrifice/cantrip/protection/mana-fix/utility-land/graveyard-hate/wheel/extra-turn/mass-land-denial/cost-reducer/tapland tag lists — gives color- and role-spread across the whole card pool without hand-typing names. (2) ~30 hand-picked on-theme staples for three panel commanders (Yuriko ninjutsu/ninjas, Sythis enchantress payoffs, Krenko goblin tribal) so the theme/high-synergy tier has guaranteed owned overlap to measure against. Regenerate part 1 by re-running the sampler described in the E122 PR against a refreshed tagger-tags.json; part 2 is manual and stable. pool (E391): the lean owned pool the app passes as collectionPool, one {name, colorIdentity, cmc, typeLine} per name, resolved once from Scryfall POST /cards/collection (75 names per request, 500ms apart; a split or double-faced card looked up by its front face). The 15 names with no paper printing (Alchemy A- cards, one Unfinity card) have no entry.
